gen-gf-goldman-inter: Inter reads smooth and tube-like, its counters breathing freely. Goldman does its best work in wide, round, commanding letters, while Inter does its best in smooth, quiet running text.
gen-gf-warnes-bitter: Stretched-out ink strokes, tapering off: that's Warnes. Bitter takes over with a very large lowercase and a gap you can see through in each s, so paragraphs feel dependable and grounded.
gen-gf-grandstander-mulish: Mulish reads in a modern, approachable way, its apertures open like a horseshoe magnet and its strokes free of modulation. Grandstander shares that constant-width line, which is the pair's glue.
gen-megrim-instrument-sans: Megrim is angular and futuristic, every stroke measured. Instrument Sans then gives text a clean, modern run, with c ends pointing apart and a stroke weight that never wavers.
gen-audiowide-gf-lexend-exa: Futuristic and tile-like, Audiowide sets its glyphs apart with wide grout lines and no thick-thin shift in its curves. Lexend Exa backs it with wide curves and stubby ascenders.
gen-tourney-gf-montserrat-alternates: Montserrat Alternates reads contemporary, with round letters and open curves. Tourney does its best work in bold, stretched, athletic words, while Montserrat Alternates is best at chalk-board lowercase that crowds the capital line.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-inter: Stencil-cut and tall, Snowburst One leaves wide bridges between its letters and an opening like a sprung paper clip. Inter then carries extended text along in smooth, tube-like lines.
gen-gf-unica-one-rubik: Rubik runs clean and soft, its lowercase large beside capitals. Unica One brings the command with single-thickness strokes and a very large lowercase eye, and Rubik softens it underneath.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-inter: Tilt Neon arrives with a splayed c terminal and a tube-like, constant-width stroke that feels bold and commanding. Inter handles the text beneath, smooth and generous in its counters.
gen-megrim-rubik: Hollow glass-tube lettering of constant thickness, angular and futuristic, defines Megrim. Rubik is at its best in clean, soft running text where big lowercase and open round letters stay clear.
